text:
support-ingrid: FYI customer reported intermittent invalid JSON from JSON-mode on /v1/generate. They see parse failures ~1-2% of requests. I attached their curl + response below. cc @eng-ml-ryan @observability-ian @sre-ellie
eng-ml-ryan: can you paste the failing response sample? we need a repro that shows the exact bytes we tried to parse
support-ingrid: sure — this is the raw body they sent back (redacted customer id):
```
{
  "items": [
    {"label": "Order", "value": "#12345"},
    {"label": "Notes", "value": "[REDACTED]"},
  ]
}
```
support-ingrid: the parser fails with `JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 4 column 27 (char 85)` when we try to run json.loads on the response. The customer says this only started after we pushed server-side redaction changes last week.
observability-ian: that sample makes it obvious — trailing comma after the last array element (`,
  ]`) plus the redaction placeholder inserted inside the string. But we currently redact in the text stream by replacing tokens, not by ensuring JSON-safe replacements.
sre-ellie: does the tracing capture the full response body? oncall-bot: Trace 1769991234 created for request id=rid_9f8a. Details: route=/v1/generate, model=redwood-lite, region=us-east-1.
katie: two quick asks: 1) short-term: can we capture a hashed+sanitized failing sample to S3 for debugging? 2) metric: bump up visibility for `json_parse_fail` per-route/customer so product can alert customers.
eng-ml-ryan: agreed. Proposed short-term mitigations:
- add a boolean trace tag `json.parse.failure=true` when parser raises.
- emit metric `json_parse_fail_count{route,model,customer_id_hash}` with reason label e.g. `trailing_comma` or `unexpected_token`.
- capture sanitized sample (replace digits and emails with `<REDACTED>` and hash customer_id) to internal S3 bucket with TTL 30d.
observability-ian: dashboard query proposal (PromQL-like):
```
sum by (route) (increase(json_parse_fail_count_total[5m])) / sum by (route) (increase(requests_total[5m]))
```
Alert: fire when > 0.5% over 10m for any paying customer.
eng-ml-ryan: root cause hypothesis: server-side redaction replaced sensitive values by inserting the string `[REDACTED]` without adjusting punctuation, sometimes placing a comma or quote incorrectly when the original was a non-string token (null/number). We should change redactor to emit `null` for non-string JSON tokens and `"<REDACTED>"` for strings, and ensure it preserves JSON structure.
support-ingrid: customer-impact note: they said some webhook consumers failed and retried, causing billing spikes for them. they asked for a mitigation ASAP.
sre-ellie: immediate playbook:
1) Turn on SDK lenient mode for affected integration to fallback to text-mode for structured output if parse fails. (SDK flag: `structured_output.strict=false`)
2) Add temporary 5xx-safe retry policy with backoff to avoid billing loops.
3) Create an alert and postmortem ticket.
observability-ian: I'll add the parse-failure metric and trace tag today; can someone own sample-capture implementation? tagging this to eng-ml.
eng-ml-ryan: I can take sample capture. Implementation notes: capture max 4KB of normalized payload, replace all digits with `#`, hash customer id with sha256 and store as `cust=sha256(..)`, redact email patterns, store gzip jsonl. Will PR to infra bucket policy for access.
katie: thanks — please add a line to the support playbook with the exact PromQL and a runbook step to toggle `structured_output.strict` per-customer via feature flag.
support-ingrid: I'll message the customer with the short-term workaround and ETA (24-48h). we'll follow up in this thread with the dashboard link and PRs. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Assigned incident-1769991234 to @eng-ml-ryan, severity=S2.
